events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, an incident that tragically led to his death days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur on hip-hop culture. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The iconic and influential guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Still influencing guitarists today, we're remembering the one and only Jimi Hendrix. What's his most iconic riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still instantly recognisable, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The unmistakable frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his stage presence. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: Imagine Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' dropped 51 years ago today. Its message of peace and unity still resonates, doesn't it?

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A masterpiece of diverse tracks and experimental sounds.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted their sound. Which track from the album is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, we remember the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His vision for peace and his incredible music continue to inspire generations.
